items.title: CVE-2026-130644
items.description: A path traversal flaw was found in ansible-core. When installing a collection with ansible-galaxy collection install, the install destination directory is derived from the namespace and name fields declared inside the collection artifact's own metadata, which are not validated as well-formed collection identifiers or checked for path containment. A malicious collection artifact -- delivered as a local file, a remote URL, a source directory, a git repository, or as a dependency -- can use a crafted name value to redirect the install destination outside the configured collections path, causing ansible-galaxy to delete an existing directory writable by the invoking user and then write attacker-controlled files to that location.

items.title: CVE-2026-130121
items.description: The AI Puffer - MCP Server for Claude & ChatGPT, with AI Chatbot plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via AI-generated comment replies in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.28 due to insufficient sanitization of the AI model's output in the insert_comment_reply_logic() function, which saves replies with wp_insert_comment() and bypasses the kses filtering WordPress normally applies to comment content. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page, by submitting a comment that leads the AI model to reproduce an HTML payload in its automated reply. items.title: CVE-2026-101113
items.description: Multiple ELECOM wireless LAN routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that may cause an arbitrary OS command to be executed by an attacker who can access the administrative interface of the affected product.

items.title: CVE-2026-131876
items.description: fqterm 0.9.9 before 0.9.11 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in its SSH client that trusts unchecked server-supplied length fields for allocations, copies and read positions. Malicious servers or man-in-the-middle attackers can send crafted lengths in getString(), KEXINIT name-lists, key parsing or packet framing before host key verification to crash the client.

items.title: CVE-2026-131875
items.description: fqterm before 0.9.11 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FQTermDecode that allows malicious servers to corrupt memory by sending CSI sequences with unbounded parameter indexes. Attackers controlling a telnet or SSH server, or intercepting cleartext telnet, can send over 30 semicolon-separated CSI parameters to write chosen 32-bit values past the decoder object on the heap.

items.title: CVE-2026-131874
items.description: Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadString() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c that fails to handle end of file. Attackers can supply an empty, truncated, or crafted .plus game file that hangs Gargoyle at full CPU until the user kills it.

items.title: CVE-2026-131873
items.description: Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadAction() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c, which never bounds-checks the index into the 1024-entry conditions array. Attackers can supply a crafted or truncated .plus game file with unterminated action conditions to write file-controlled values past the array and crash the player.

items.title: CVE-2026-131872
items.description: SOIL2 before 1.4.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in its DDS, PVR and PKM image loaders that write results through unchecked caller-supplied output pointers. Attackers can supply a valid DDS, PVR or PKM file to applications passing NULL output pointers to SOIL_load_image or stbi_info, causing a crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-131871
items.description: WLA DX 9.7 through 10.7 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in parse_data_blocks() in wlalink/analyze.c that copies section namespaces without length checks. Attackers can supply a crafted object or library file with a namespace longer than 255 bytes or unterminated to overflow the 256-byte stack buffer when linked.

items.title: CVE-2026-131800
items.description: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an organization member with permission to manage custom-property definitions and edit property values to add an attacker-controlled SSH authentication key to the personal account of another member through HTML stored in a single-select custom-property option. Exploitation required another definition manager in the same organization to attempt to remove the poisoned option while it was in use and save the definition with a valid sudo session. Repository access through the added key depended on the permissions of the victim and independent authorization controls. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: CVE-2026-125411
items.description: Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the access control of Items. If this vulnerability is exploited, a remote authenticated attacker who can view records in the affected product may obtain the values of Items for which read access is restricted by Column access control. Note that the vulnerability affects configurations where read access conditions are set in Column access control settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-125276
items.description: Pleasanter contains an issue with insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the API. If the affected product receives a specially crafted API request sent by a remote authenticated attacker, the authentication credentials of other users, including administrators, such as API keys, may be obtained. As a result, the attacker may perform arbitrary operations on the affected product with the privileges associated with the obtained credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-121811
items.description: Pleasanter contains an issue with improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('Path Traversal') in the API. If this vulnerability is exploited, an arbitrary file on the server where the product is running may be obtained by a remote authenticated attacker.

items.title: CVE-2026-120472
items.description: A flaw was found in OpenShift Hive. The ClusterClaim controller assigns hive-claim-owner RBAC based on a user-controlled ClusterClaim.spec.namespace and only verifies ClusterPoolRef.ClaimName. A tenant can point a same-named claim at another tenant's ClusterDeployment and obtain get access to that cluster's admin kubeconfig and admin password secrets.

items.title: CVE-2026-117634
items.description: Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in Publishing feature. If this vulnerability is exploited, a remote unauthenticated attacker who can access a site published using the product may obtain, by sending a specially crafted request, information on records of unpublished sites (e.g., titles), as well as the names of users, groups, and organizations registered in the same tenant. Note that the vulnerability only affects configurations where both of the following conditions are met: a site is published using the Publishing feature, and the published site contains link items (items linked to other sites, users, groups, or organizations).

items.title: CVE-2026-107950
items.description: An XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability affects a Storefront REST API in HCL Commerce versions 8, 9.0.1 and 9.1.x.  A remote attacker, using a specially crafted XML, could potentially view internal files or consume memory resources.

items.title: CVE-2026-107949
items.description: A SQL injection vulnerability affects an administrative API in HCL Commerce versions 8, 9.0.1 and 9.1.0 - 9.1.21.  A remote attacker with an administrative role could use a crafted URL to infer unauthorized data from the database.

items.title: CVE-2026-93459
items.description:
Use of externally-controlled format string in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a nearby administrator to read or write memory, potentially resulting in a denial-of-service, via crafted format specifiers sent to the logging/summary function.
Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-93458
items.description:
Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a remote attacker to obtain router’s UID or login authorization tokens for the victim's linked account via a crafted web page, which requires a logged-in router administrator to actively complete the third-party authorization flow.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-88760
items.description:
Missing Authentication for Critical
Function in certain ASUS Router firmware allows unauthenticated nearby users to
obtain router information and resources (e.g., multimedia files) via HTTP
requests.
Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-88711
items.description:
Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command in certain ASUS Router firmware models allows an remote attacker to to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges by inducing a logged-in administrator to visit a malicious website.
Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-19399
items.description:
Improper Authentication and Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') in ASUS Router firmware allow an unauthenticated nearby user to perform file operations or read files in an unintended directory via crafted HTTP requests during an active user session.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-131820
items.description: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated user with repository write access to send requests to internal services through Slack webhook validity checks, potentially leading to remote code execution on the appliance. Exploitation required Secret Protection with secret scanning and validity checks for partner patterns enabled. This vulnerability affected all versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, and 3.20.12. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: CVE-2026-131647
items.description: A CRLF injection vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed a user with write access to a repository to bypass branch protections and update branches or tags in that repository through specially crafted input when resolving pull request conflicts. This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: CVE-2026-126574
items.description:
Missing authorization vulnerability in ASUS Control Center Datacenter and Control Center Enterprise allows remote authenticated users with a low-privileged Viewer role to change the password of an Administrator account, thereby obtaining administrative privileges, via a crafted password update request. 
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Control Center  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-119469
items.description:
Incorrect default permissions in the ASUS DisplayWidget Center allow a local, low-privileged user to achieve arbitrary code execution in the security context of another user via a crafted executable placed in that user-writable directory, which the application launches when the other user runs it and uses a particular feature.Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Display Widget Center ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-116643
items.description: An SSH certificate authentication bypass vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated organization member to read and modify another user's private repositories within the trusted certificate authority's scope. Exploitation required an instance using built-in authentication and a valid certificate issued to the attacker by a trusted SSH certificate authority. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: CVE-2026-116637
items.description: A site administrator could modify files on the appliance host with root privileges and disclose private repository data due to improper path validation in GitHub Enterprise Server. Exploitation required a crafted pre-receive hook environment. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: CVE-2026-114205
items.description:
Incorrect authorization in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote authenticated user with a low-privileged role to create an administrator account, resulting in administrative control of the management console and of the clients it manages.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-114204
items.description:
Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to bypass authentication by forging a session token for an account with a recent valid login, resulting in administrative control of the management console and of the clients it manages.
Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-114202
items.description:
Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to gain administrative privileges via a forged authentication token.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-112117
items.description:
A Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') in ASUS System Control Interface , allows a local, low-privileged user to gain full control over arbitrary existing files and folders outside the allowed directories via a crafted path containing dot-segment sequences that satisfies a folder prefix check, which can lead to unauthorized read and modification of protected files and may result in local privilege escalation.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS System Control Interface  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-112115
items.description:
An untrusted search path in ASUS Armoury Crate allows a local, low-privileged user to achieve privilege escalation by executing a crafted library at a high integrity level, via user-controlled environment settings inherited by an elevated process.
Refer to the '
Security Update for Armoury Crate App ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-110307
items.description: An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated user whose numeric user ID matched an enterprise's numeric ID to manage that enterprise's GitHub Apps and generate private keys without enterprise membership. GitHub App ownership checks compared numeric IDs without checking the owner's account type. Exploitation required control of a session for the colliding user account and an enterprise-owned GitHub App. A generated private key could be used to authenticate as the App and access repositories where it was installed, within its granted permissions. On standard fresh installations, the documented collision involved the non-loginable built-in ghost account; the reported GHES reproduction used site administrator impersonation. items.title: CVE-2026-106096
items.description: A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, the host pod log directory is bind-mounted into a pod emptyDir and is intended to be read-only, but Linux ignores MS_RDONLY on the initial bind and the CRI mount stays writable. A non-privileged UID 0 container can place a symlink at a future kubelet log path so that privileged conmon later appends attacker-controlled log data to an existing host file. This is an append-only host integrity issue, not universal remote code execution; LinkLogs is not enabled by default.

items.title: CVE-2026-105929
items.description: A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-galaxy role installation. An explicit role "name" taken from a role's meta/requirements.yml is used to construct the on-disk installation path without validating that the resulting destination stays within the selected roles directory. A name containing "../" escapes that directory, and an absolute name replaces it entirely. Because ansible-galaxy processes transitive dependencies from an installed role's meta/requirements.yml, a malicious role publisher can cause attacker-supplied files to be written outside the operator's chosen roles directory when the operator installs the role, and, when --force is used, can cause an existing role directory outside that path to be removed and replaced. The impact is bounded by the invoking user's filesystem permissions and requires the operator to install the attacker-influe

items.title: CVE-2026-112740
items.description: A command injection vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated site administrator to execute arbitrary commands as the host git user on peer Git server nodes outside the pre-receive hook sandbox by supplying a crafted pre-receive environment download URL. Exploitation required a clustered deployment using custom pre-receive hook environments and at least one peer Git server node. This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, 3.20.12, and 3.19.16. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: CVE-2026-111801
items.description: An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed authenticated users to read review-thread data from private repositories they could not access. An attacker required an authenticated account, a readable repository and pull request to use as the request context, and target review-thread identifiers. The thread-preview endpoint resolved supplied identifiers without restricting them to the authorized pull request, exposing private file paths and, when positioning and diff data were available, source-code excerpts, commit identifiers, and line metadata without victim interaction. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases in the 3.21, 3.22 series and was fixed in versions 3.21.10, 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: CVE-2026-92182
items.description:
Netgate pfSense CE XMLRPC Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Netgate pfSense. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the XMLRPC endpoint. The issue results from incorrect authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code within the context of the root. Was ZDI-CAN-32353.

items.title: CVE-2026-131857
items.description: Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in stdio-to-SSE mode that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the gateway via prototype-inherited sessionId values. Attackers can send a POST message request with sessionId set to toString or constructor, triggering an unhandled TypeError that terminates every attached MCP session.

items.title: CVE-2026-131856
items.description: Pika before 1.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource allocation vulnerability that allows malicious brokers to exhaust client memory by declaring oversized frame payloads. Attackers can send frame headers declaring up to 4 GiB payloads, unchecked against frame_max, or very large message bodies to terminate consuming applications.

items.title: CVE-2026-131855
items.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_vnc() in src/dissectors/ec_vnc.c that checks total packet length instead of remaining bytes. A malicious VNC server can send the authentication type and challenge in one short packet to leak up to 3 bytes of adjacent heap memory via the logged challenge.

items.title: CVE-2026-131854
items.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds checks. A malicious MySQL server or client can send truncated greeting or login packets to leak adjacent heap memory through hex-encoded output in the interface and log.

items.title: CVE-2026-131853
items.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_ssh() in src/dissectors/ec_ssh.c that copies a peer-supplied data_len without checking remaining packet bytes. A malicious SSHv1 client or server in an intercepted session can send a short packet with a large data_len to disclose up to 64 bytes of adjacent heap memory through captured credentials in the interface and log.

items.title: CVE-2026-131852
items.description: OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 contains a format string vulnerability in json_response() and related output functions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code by storing a malicious tid value. Attackers can publish locations via POST /pub or MQTT with printf specifiers in tid, then read them back through GET /api/0/last to leak addresses and write memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-131851
items.description: ILIAS before 9.25, 10.13, and 11.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in ilPRGAssignmentFilter::toConditions() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through the StudyProgramme members list Name and Status filters. Attackers holding only the OrgUnit permission to view members can break out of LIKE literals and execute stacked statements, such as overwriting the root password hash to gain administrative control.

items.title: CVE-2026-131850
items.description: ILIAS 11.0 before 11.6 contains an sql injection vulnerability in RegistrationCodeRepository::getCodesData() that concatenates unvalidated sort fields into an ORDER BY clause. Authenticated users with read access to the Authentication and Registration administration node can supply SQL expressions as the sort parameter to extract database contents via boolean-based inference.

items.title: CVE-2026-131849
items.description: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL() that allows malicious PLCs to overwrite client memory by sending oversized multi-slice SZL responses. A rogue or impersonated PLC can keep flagging more data with attacker-controlled DLen slices, overflowing the 65536-byte opData buffer via Cli_ReadSZL() and Cli_ReadSZLList(), crashing the client and corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-131848
items.description: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars() that allows malicious PLCs to overflow client buffers via unchecked DataLength fields. Attackers controlling or impersonating a PLC can return crafted ReadVar responses to Cli_ReadMultiVars() callers, writing up to 65535 bytes per item to corrupt memory and crash clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-131847
items.description: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in NSSCryptoSignBackend.cc that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed CMS arena memory during repeated signature verification. Attackers can supply a signed PDF embedding the signer certificate to crash applications or pdfsig runs validating multiple signatures, or cause incorrect certificate validation results.

items.title: CVE-2026-131846
items.description: Poppler 0.76.1 through 26.11.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SplashOutputDev::iccTransform() that allows attackers to write out of bounds when rendering in splashModeDeviceN8. Attackers can supply a PDF with an ICCBased image whose alternate is DeviceN, causing getDeviceNLine() to overflow the per-row buffer, crashing the renderer and corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-131845
items.description: Poppler 21.01.0 through 26.11.0 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in FormWidgetSignature::signDocument() that allows local attackers to obtain valid signatures over altered content. Attackers with write access to the output file or directory can overwrite or swap the PDF between writing and hashing, causing the signer's key to sign attacker-controlled content.

items.title: CVE-2026-131844
items.description: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in the libcurl-based remote file loader that trusts unvalidated HEAD Content-Length values in CurlCachedFileLoader::init(). Malicious HTTP servers can return an enormous Content-Length so CachedFile resizes its chunk cache accordingly, aborting pdfinfo or PDFDocFactory-based applications with std::bad_alloc for denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-131843
items.description: Poppler pdftohtml through 26.11.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in HtmlLink::getLinkStart() in utils/HtmlLinks.cc that writes PDF link annotation URIs into href attributes without escaping in HTML output modes. Attackers can craft a PDF whose /URI entry contains a double quote followed by HTML markup or event handlers to execute script in browsers viewing the generated HTML.

items.title: CVE-2026-131842
items.description: Poppler pdfdetach 24.03.0 through 26.11.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in utils/pdfdetach.cc that allows attackers to write files outside the output directory by bypassing a string-prefix containment check. Attackers can craft PDFs with embedded file names containing '..' sequences or absolute paths, so -saveall or -savefile extraction creates or overwrites files with the invoking user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-130600
items.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons bdthemes-element-pack-lite allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects Element Pack Elementor Addons: from n/a through 10.0.9.

items.title: CVE-2026-129892
items.description:
IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl allow code injection via a fetched list line that closes the built-in data heredoc when update_self_from_url rewrites the module's source.

The rewrite copies the module's source down to the built-in list's heredoc and appends each fetched line below it. Nothing checks that a line looks like a domain. A line that is not a comment loses only what follows a `//` and its trailing whitespace, so a line reading END_BUILTIN_DATA is appended as it stands and ends the data block in the rewritten file. Every fetched line after it is Perl.

Arbitrary Perl runs in every process that loads IO::Socket::SSL, which loads this module unconditionally, until the file is reinstalled. The attacker must control the fetched list, through the cleartext default URL or a caller-supplied one, and the updater must run with write access to the installed

items.title: CVE-2026-129891
items.description:
IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl let an on-path attacker choose the installed public suffix list because update_self_from_url fetches it over cleartext HTTP with no integrity check.

Called with no argument, as the module's documentation shows, the updater fetches the list from the `http://` address in the URL constant and checks only that the request succeeded, with no signature or digest over the response. The lines that come back are written into the module's own source file as the built-in list.

An attacker on the network path when the updater runs chooses the suffix boundary the module reports to every caller on the host, and that answer persists in the installed module until it is reinstalled. Dropping one rule makes the hostname check in IO::Socket::SSL accept a wildcard certificate that spans the whole public suffix that rule named.

items.title: CVE-2026-129069
items.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in John-Michael L'Allier Create mediavine-create allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Create: from n/a through 3.1.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-129049
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Go Maps WP Go Maps wp-google-maps allows Stored XSS.This issue affects WP Go Maps: from n/a through 10.1.12.

items.title: CVE-2026-129040
items.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP User Manager WP User Manager wp-user-manager allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP User Manager: from n/a through 2.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-126980
items.description:
Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Observable Discrepancy Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Authentication service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When processing crafted pairing requests, the service discloses internal information via an observable discrepancy between possible responses. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28470.

items.title: CVE-2026-126979
items.description:
Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Accessory Protocol chacha20_decrypt Integer Underflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Accessory Protocol service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing pairing requests, the process does not properly validate user-supplied data, which can result in an integer underflow before writing to memory. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28332.

items.title: CVE-2026-126978
items.description:
Philips Hue Bridge hap_pair_setup_handler Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Accessory Protocol service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing pairing requests, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28434.

items.title: CVE-2026-126977
items.description:
Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Pair-Setup Default Password Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Authentication service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. Crafted data in a pairing request can cause the device to allow authentication using a blank password. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28323.

items.title: CVE-2026-126976
items.description:
llama.cpp MTMD Multimodal GGUF File Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of llama.cpp. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of audio multimodal projector GGUF files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer overflow before allocating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-30980.

items.title: CVE-2026-126975
items.description:
llama.cpp GGUF File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of llama.cpp. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

items.title: CVE-2026-124024
items.description:
Converting crafted input from UCS-4 to IBM1390 or IBM1399 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.3.3 and later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash.

When converting from UCS-4, these encoders may encounter a combining base such as U+00E6 and jump ahead by 4 bytes to check the next UCS-4 code point.  The check for end of buffer however does not account for this, which may result in a buffer overread if the following code point has less than 4 bytes remaining.  Exploitation of this bug not only requires attacker control of input and encoding, but also strict control over layout of the input in memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-121758
items.description:
Converting crafted ISO-2022-CN-EXT input to UTF-8 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.2 through 2.44 may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash.

When the ISO-2022-CN-EXT decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\x0e' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice.  If this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer.  To exploit this, the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

items.title: CVE-2026-121757
items.description:
Converting crafted CP949 input to UTF-8 character encoding and ignoring invalid characters, in the GNU C Library version 2.1 or later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash.

When the CP949 decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\xa2\xe8' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice.  If //IGNORE is set on the destination encoding and this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer.  To exploit this, the target iconv function needs to set //IGNORE on the destination of the conversion and the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

items.title: CVE-2026-69187
items.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.9.1, web/controle/control.php authorizes FuncionarioControle requests only by checking whether an authenticated employee has a permission row for resource 11 or 91, while MiddlewareDAO::verificarPermissao() does not compare the stored id_acao value or authorize the requested method. An employee with any such permission and a valid CSRF token from the employee's own session can invoke FuncionarioControle::adicionarPermissao, FuncionarioControle::alterarPermissao, or FuncionarioControle::excluirPermissao to add, change, or remove permissions for arbitrary roles. This can grant higher action levels over sensitive resources, expose or modify protected employee, patient, configuration, and administrative data, or disrupt legitimate access by changing other roles. This issue is fixed in version 3.9.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-63193
items.description: October System provides the system module for October Content Management System. Prior to 3.7.18 and 4.3.2, the Media Library MediaManager::onCropImage and cropImage path accepts a user-controlled destination filename without applying the default_extensions allowlist enforced by the normal upload path. An authenticated backend user with media.library.create permission can upload arbitrary bytes under an allowed extension and use the zero-dimension crop branch, which performs a byte-for-byte File::copy, to write those bytes into the public media folder under an attacker-selected extension. Default server configurations block PHP execution in that folder, but HTML or SVG output can produce stored cross-site scripting in the application origin; non-default servers that execute PHP in the media directory can expose remote code execution. This vulnerability is fixed in 3.7.18 and 4.3.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-61715
items.description: Servo is a lightweight, high-performance web rendering engine for embedding web technologies in applications. Prior to 0.4.0, a frame with sandbox="" can reach and execute a javascript: URL through declarative refresh because RefreshRedirectDue::invoke() in components/script/dom/document/document.rs can reach JavaScript URL handling in components/script/script_thread.rs without enforcing the sandbox's script prohibition. This gives attacker-controlled content arbitrary JavaScript execution in a frame intended to be scriptless, including nested DOM probe creation and blind browser requests. The frame retains an opaque origin, so the issue does not by itself provide parent DOM access. This issue is fixed in version 0.4.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-61713
items.description: Servo is a lightweight, high-performance web rendering engine for embedding web technologies in applications. Prior to 0.3.0, a sandboxed iframe can use declarative refresh to auto-navigate because RefreshRedirectDue::invoke() in components/script/dom/document/document.rs does not enforce the sandboxed automatic-features flag. The bypass occurs with sandbox="", sandbox="allow-same-origin", sandbox="allow-forms", and sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-forms". Attacker-controlled framed content can replace itself without user action, enabling framed phishing, content replacement, redirect loops, and limited denial of service, but the issue does not by itself permit script execution or parent DOM access. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-61689
items.description: XWiki Platform is a generic wiki platform. From 4.3-milestone-1 until 16.10.18, 17.10.5, and 18.2.0, the /rest/wikis/{wikiName}/query REST endpoint permits HQL query construction that can combine blind conditions with FROM-clause injection to join BaseObject and StringProperty, bypassing the SELECT-column whitelist. An unauthenticated attacker can recover database values from inaccessible pages, including salted SHA1 password hashes and passwords stored in configuration properties. It should be assumed that, with more complex techniques, this can work even when the attacker cannot read any wiki page. A typical password hash may require roughly 800 requests, and expensive injected queries can also degrade availability. The issue is remediated by disabling HQL and XWQL REST queries by default. This issue is fixed in versions 16.10.18, 17.10.5, and 18.2.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-129510
items.description:
Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the XmlLayout and XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J of Apache log4net.

Both layouts split a message holding the CDATA end marker into several CDATA sections, but searched for the marker with a culture-sensitive comparison. Ignorable characters or a combining mark around the marker made the search miss it, so the CDATA section stayed open. From 3.3.1 on, an XML parser then reads the following log events as part of that message; earlier versions leave the log file not well-formed. A party whose data reaches a log message could hide later log events from a consumer that parses the XML log.

This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.
